segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin generally recommend the balm, saying it removes makeup without adding grease, though one reviewer notes her oily-skinned sister found it too greasy and preferred a formula made for oily skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including several describing it as very dry or extremely dry, are the most consistently enthusiastic group, reporting the balm cleanses thoroughly without leaving skin tight, stripped or stiff, though one reviewer with super dry skin found it slightly drying and needed a second cleanser.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin say it removes makeup well without making them oilier or drier, and rate it above similar balms they have tried.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin mostly report no irritation or breakouts and successful makeup removal, but one reviewer developed itchy skin she suspected was an allergic reaction, and another with migraine-level scent sensitivity found the fragrance nauseating.
segments.mature: A reviewer over 60 and a 54-year-old reviewer both praise it as a favorite for mature skin, citing softer texture and smaller-looking pores, though neither reports visible wrinkle reduction.

concerns.aging: Two mature reviewers (54 and 60+) report smoother texture, brighter look, and one notes softened fine lines on the forehead, though one explicitly says she saw no reduction in wrinkles and wasn't expecting any.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin describe the balm as hydrating and non-stripping, leaving skin soft rather than tight; one review nonetheless found it left a stripping, drying feeling despite advertised moisture.
concerns.redness: Only one reviewer mentions redness, noting she tends to get some redness after cleansing but that the balm otherwise leaves her skin glowing.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer chose this product specifically to avoid over-exfoliating and damaging her skin barrier, reporting improved texture and healthier-looking skin; another using it while on Accutane found it did not strip her already-compromised skin.
concerns.spots: One reviewer highlights reduced blackheads and smaller-looking pores after use, and another reports her nose pores felt less congested.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers, including ones with acne-prone or cystic-acne skin, report no new breakouts and one notes a decrease in acne; one oil-cleanser-sensitive reviewer says most oil cleansers cause her to break out but this one did not.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination-oily skin generally say it cleans oil without leaving a greasy film, though it is oil-based and one dry-skinned user reports the initial application feels oily before rinsing off completely.

I felt like I had to double cleanse with a different (non oily) cleanser to remove any residue. I think this product would be best for oily skinned people. Since I have super dry skin it felt a little stripping.

extraits.titre: Don't know how I lived without
extraits.texte: Love love!! Firstly you don't need a lot. The first time I mistakenly used too much it still worked terrifically but gosh what a waste😅 I've had a hard time with my dry skin no matter how much I've moisturized a friend of mine recommended this after he noticed I mostly had stubborn dry flakes. In addition, it helped shrink my pores remove makeup leaving my skin smooth. I made my younger sister try and she fell in love however since she's oily skin type it wasn't working 100% for her and sometimes felt too grease. so I got her the oily one and so far she's told me it's amazing! So I suggest that you take a moment to consider your skin type if not this will not work for you.💕

I have extremely dry sensitive skin. I also wear makeup everyday to work and it is on my skin for at least 11 hours. Plus, I live in the city....lots of smog and stuff. So, taking care of my skin is important. I picked this up when it first launched, the claims were intriguing. I have been using it consistently now for 2 weeks and my skin looks better than it has in a very long time! I am hydrated, the texture is much smoother and I just look healthy and beautiful. I have not noticed a decrease in wrinkles, ( I am 54), but I truly was not expecting too. My pores have not disappeared but they have become smaller in size. The product itself is a balm. It comes with a tiny spatula, which I like. You pick up a small amount, warm it up on your fingers than apply to face. It smells clean and like oranges. If you are sensitive to scents you might want to steer clear or test it out first. The fun part is when you activate the balm with warm water. You place some water on your face and the product turns a milky white. And it just feels so nice. After rinsing and patting dry you can add your favorite moisturizer but honestly I have not needed to. Does it remove all makeup? Yes. I have been putting it through the paces. I have not removed any makeup with wipes before using this product and it has taken everything off;mascara, lippies, blush, bronzer, foundation....all of it. I highly recommend this product and will definitely be repurchasing.

I love thus product and the way my skin feels after using. It melts my eye makeup for easy removal. Let me say that no, it doesn't COMPLETELY remove my eye makeup, but what cleanser does? I do have some residual that needs to be removed with a minimum of eyemake remover. A little of this balm goes a long way. One of my favorite products for my 60+ years skin!

This might have been a great product? I chose this cleansing balm because of the AHA ingredient & price but sadly, I think I might be allergic to one of its ingredients. My face & neck itches like crazy the 2 evenings I used it. I won't be using it anymore. I used a different brand before this one and I did not have any negative reactions.

I have oily/combination acne-prone skin, and using an oil-based cleanser has been a game changer for me. I have previously used other Korean cleansing balms, and this one is very good. It removes all my makeup and leaves my skin soft and clean. This is very subjective, but I am not a fan of the citrusy scent. Other than that, I recommend and would personally buy again and again.
